Definition
[Einstein manifold]

Source: petersen:page-0103, petersen:page-0104 ↗ def:pet-ch3-ricci-curvature

Write $\operatorname {Ric}\ge k$ if, at every $p\in M$, each eigenvalue of the Ricci endomorphism $\operatorname {Ric}_p:T_pM\to T_pM$ is $\ge k$; equivalently, $\operatorname {Ric}(v,v)\ge kg(v,v)$ for every tangent vector $v$. $(M,g)$ is an Einstein manifold with Einstein constant $k$ if $\operatorname {Ric}(v)=k\cdot v$ for all $v$, equivalently $\operatorname {Ric}(v,w)=k\cdot g(v,w)$.
